summary: CareDx filed an 8-K/A amending its original July 7, 2026 report on the completed acquisition of Naveris, Inc., a Delaware diagnostics company. This amendment supplies Naveris' audited FY2025 financial statements, unaudited Q1 2026 statements, and Article 11 pro forma combined financials, plus auditor PricewaterhouseCoopers' consent. No purchase price, share count, premium, or closing date beyond June 30, 2026 is disclosed in this excerpt. The transaction has already closed, so the filing is purely financial-statement remediation. What to watch: integration execution, Naveris revenue contribution to pro forma results, and any purchase-accounting adjustments or earnout disclosures.
